news.title: Douglasville man sentenced to life for sexually assaulting infant, DA says
news.summary: A 22-year-old Douglasville man has been sentenced to life in prison after pleading guilty to sexually assaulting a 10-month-old infant, prosecutors announced Tuesday.

news.title: How the FBI was tipped off to an alleged threat to shoot up a Cherokee County high school
news.summary: A tip to the FBI led to an investigation and three arrests in an alleged plot to carry out a school shooting at Cherokee High School.

news.title: 3 arrested for planning to shoot up metro Atlanta school; guns and ammo seized, police say
news.summary: A juvenile, a teenager from coastal Georgia and a man from California were arrested for targeting the Cherokee County school.

news.title: Search for suspects after man beaten, carjacked in southwest Atlanta: APD
news.summary: Police are asking for the public's help to identify armed suspects accused of beating a man and stealing his car in southwest Atlanta last Friday.

news.title: Newnan police shooting review hinges on self-defense, not chase, DA says
news.summary: The criminal review into the fatal police shooting of 18-year-old Zadarious Dorsey hinges on self-defense rather than whether the officer had legal grounds to chase him, prosecutors announced.

news.title: ‘Unthinkable:’ Neighbors leave flowers, teddy bears for 4-year-old found dead inside Atlanta home
news.summary: Channel 2 Action News learned the name of the 4-year-old boy found dead inside a southwest Atlanta home.

news.title: Three arrested in alleged plot to carry out a shooting at Cherokee High School
news.summary: Three individuals have been arrested for an alleged plot to shoot at Cherokee High School, according to Canton police.

news.title: 3 arrested in alleged Cherokee High School shooting plot
news.summary: Canton police have taken three people into custody after uncovering an alleged conspiracy to commit a shooting at Cherokee High School.

news.title: New DNA tech sparks potential leads in 2005 Dallas killing
news.summary: New forensic testing is providing fresh hope to family members and detectives working to solve the 21-year-old murder of a Dallas man.

news.title: Driver arrested after 95 mph chase on I-20 ends in crash
news.summary: A high-speed police pursuit through DeKalb County ended Tuesday with a driver in custody after sideswiping two cars and trying to run from a state trooper.

news.title: Woman arrested in Augusta area after child found dead in southwest Atlanta, sources say
news.summary: Police have not officially released the child's identity or exact age; sources told 11Alive the child is a 4-year-old boy.

news.title: Family says brother of 4-year-old found dead in Atlanta home also seriously injured
news.summary: Jasmaine Smoak, 32, who is not the boys' mother, was arrested in Wilkes County.

news.title: Nigerian citizen extradited to Atlanta in $100M tax fraud scheme
news.summary: A Nigerian citizen was arraigned in Atlanta after being extradited from Benin to face federal charges for his alleged role in a $100 million stolen identity tax fraud scheme.

news.title: Mom's friend arrested after 4-year-old found dead in SW Atlanta
news.summary: A woman was arrested after authorities found a 4-year-old boy dead inside a southwest Atlanta townhouse on Sunday night.

news.title: 30-year-old man arrested on multiple counts of sex crimes involving children in DeKalb Co.
news.summary: He was taken into custody on six counts of sexual exploitation of children on Friday, October 2026, and booked into the DeKalb County Jail.
